summary: Nyxoah SA filed a 6-K reporting an underwritten public offering of 55,232,558 ordinary shares at $1.72 per share, with an over-allotment option, under an existing F-3 shelf registration statement. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. It closed on June 9, 2026, netting ~$88.5M. No special-situation features (e.g., activist, tender, restructuring) are present; this is an ordinary shelf takedown. Adjust for non-US: 6-K is the foreign private issuer equivalent of an 8-K for material events. Nothing further to watch.
